animMotion-mode.label: Mode
animMotion-mode.tip: Determines how the animation switches motion directions

8-dir.name: 8 Directional
8-dir.tip: Down, Left, Right, Up, Down-Left, Down-Right, Up-Left, Up-Right

5-dir-mirror.name: 5 Directional - Mirror
5-dir-mirror.tip: Down, Right, Up, Down-Right, Up-Right, Mirror (Left, Down-Left, Up-Left)

animMotion-skip.label: Skip Last Frame
animMotion-skip.tip: Skip the last frame when the animation reaches the end (used for looping transition animations)

animMotion-loop.label: Loop
animMotion-loop.tip: Automatically returns to the starting frame and continues playing after the animation ends
